files.README.md:
# turbine curtailment journal

Carnmoor Renewables' site controller writes one line to logs/curtailment.log
for every instruction the grid sends the Fellview turbines:

    <UTC time> <turbine> <event> setpoint_kw=<n>

CURTAIL records an instruction to hold a turbine back and RELEASE records that
instruction being lifted; `setpoint_kw` is the output the instruction held the
turbine to. The journal covers three days and is closed with a line whose count
covers every instruction line above it.
